Hi Philipp,

I'm sorry. You've written three times and all you've had back is a holding line. You deserved a real answer days ago, so here it is.

You ordered your Magic M. 40T on September 3, and it is paid and set to ship to (address hidden). Your EU Power K. and Miner D. are already set aside for you at our Rotterdam warehouse. They will go in the same box as the miner.

The miners ship out from the factory on November 12. Some units were already packed and with the freight forwarder. Once they reach Rotterdam, your order ships from inside the EU, so there is no import VAT or duty to pay on delivery. You can follow the shipment to our warehouse at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status, and your tracking number is emailed to you the moment your miner ships.

There is also a setup problem on your order in our warehouse's system that needs fixing so your miner can ship once it arrives. A colleague is working on that today, and you'll get an email when it's done.

We wrote to you on November 3 and November 8. If those emails didn't reach you, please check your spam folder. Add (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts so the tracking email reaches you.

Kind regards,
Sarah
